decision: Zur erneuten Motivfreigabe vorgeschlagen: direkte Ableitung aus A-r01, breiterer offener Spalt, aufrechte Silhouette und nach unten gebogene Klauen. Rasterwirkung noch ungeprüft.
prompt: Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. The input is the approved claw hammer reveal and the ONLY authoritative image. Derive a new separate simplified monochrome MOTIF TEMPLATE, preserving this exact almost vertical orientation, silhouette, short broad hammer head, round striking face on the LEFT, TWO curved claws pointing DOWN on the RIGHT, and long vertical connected handle with a gently flared rounded bottom. Keep the same relative proportions and perspective. Convert all hammer material, outlines, light and texture to ONE uniform solid BLACK connected silhouette on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. One deliberate abstraction change is required: WIDEN the OPEN slit between the two claw prongs substantially into a broad transparent curved V-shaped wedge, visibly open to the outside at the tips, rather than the original hairline. Two separate down-curving stout tines, spaced about one tenth of the entire head width at their free ends. Do not turn the tines horizontal. Keep the concave transparent space below the claw. All other parts of the hammer must stay connected, without interior white lines or added holes, especially the striking face and head. Full hammer visible, narrow transparent margin, portrait around 2:3. No pixel art, grid, numbers, text, shadows, floor, extra objects, grey, gradients or texture. This is the simplified drawing, not the finished cell matrix. Output ONE PNG.
